posts.text: Nye angrep av Houti militsen nå idag mot Saudi-Arabia  Crucially, this includes another claimed strike on vital East-West crude pipeline pumping stations. The targets listed by Saree include the following: King Khalid Airport in Riyadh Aramco facilities in Yanbu Rabigh oil refinery  East-West crude pipeline pumping stations King Fahd Airport in Dammam Najran Airport Khamis Mushait Air Base
